data.name: Dzakir
data.gender_notes: Dzakir is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic root 'z-k-r' which means 'to remember'. In Islamic context, it signifies being a constant reminder of Allah through one's actions, speech and thoughts. The name Dzakir carries the meaning “Remembrance of Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Dzakir usually hope their child will grow to embody remembrance of allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that inspires one to remember Allah at all times.
data.etymology: Dzakir belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Remembrance of Allah.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dzakir total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
